data.name: Variant Channeling - Dreams
data.description: Heal - Creatures affected by sleep effects may attempt another saving throw and apply the +%1 channel bonus on the roll. Willingly sleeping creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on saving throws and Perception checks for up to 8 hours (this bonus ends if the creature awakens). Harm - Creatures gain a -%1 channel penalty on Perception checks and saving throws against exhaustion, fatigue, and sleep effects for 1 minute.|ChannelModifier
